500.description: Challenge could not be created safely

post.summary: Verify a browser-bound phone login OTP and create the existing JWT session

parameters.name: yte_phone_binding
parameters.description: HttpOnly browser correlation cookie issued with the phone challenge.

400.description: Challenge is invalid, expired, replayed, or bound to another browser

post.summary: Verify a phone OTP and link the identity to the authenticated account

parameters.name: yte_phone_binding
parameters.description: HttpOnly browser correlation cookie issued with the phone challenge.

400.description: Challenge is invalid, expired, replayed, or bound to another context

401.description: Authentication is required or OTP is invalid

500.description: Phone identity could not be linked safely
